title: Russia and Japan clash over the Kuril Islands, and one nuclear weapon is used at sea

strikes.launch_name: Russian Bastion-P coastal battery, Kunashir (location simulated)
strikes.notes: day 3, conventional; the Bastion batteries on Kunashir and Iturup are real (A15), the firing is the simulation's choice

strikes.launch_name: Japan Ground Self-Defense Force long-range missile unit, Hokkaido (location simulated)
strikes.weapon: Type-12 improved surface-to-ship missile (assumed in Hokkaido)
strikes.notes: day 5, conventional counterstrike; about 1,000 km class missile (A24) assumed in Hokkaido, which is the simulation's choice

strikes.launch_name: Russian Pacific Fleet submarine, Sea of Okhotsk (location simulated)
strikes.target_name: Japanese and US escort group, Pacific off south-east Hokkaido
strikes.notes: day 7 launch, airburst at sea; the navy holds about 767 non-strategic warheads per one estimate (A20); 10 kt is a simulation choice, the low end of the published 10 to 100 kt envelope for Russian battlefield warheads (016 A12, single-source)
